data.name: Muflah
data.gender_notes: Muflah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'f-l-h', meaning 'knowledge' or 'wisdom'. A name for a boy who is considered intelligent and knowledgeable. The name Muflah carries the meaning “Knowledgeable, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Muflah usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledgeable, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom in one's life, reflecting a deep connection to the divine.
data.etymology: Muflah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledgeable, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muflah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: مفلح
in_arabic.long_meaning: مفلح: الاسم المأخوذ من الجذر الفعل (ف-ل-ح) بمعنى البركة ومحبة الله، وهو من أسماء الصالحين في القرآن الكريم، ويُعتبر اسمًا مقدسًا في الإسلام، ويُستخدم لتسمية الأطفال كتسمية شكرًا على النعمة والمحبة التي يُحسّنها الله عزّ وجلّ. ويُعتبر أيضًا إشارة إلى الأمانة والوفاء في أداء الواجب، ويمكن أن يكون بمعنى الخير والصلاح. وفي بعض الأحيان يُستخدم لتسمية الأطفال كتسمية للبركاة والمجد، ويعتبر من أسماء الشعراء والمشاعير في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: مفلح
in_urdu.long_meaning: مفلح: یہ نام Arabic زبان کے جڑ (ف-ل-ح) سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے برکت اور اللہ کی محبت، یہ قرآن میں صالحین کے ناموں میں سے ہے، اسلامی روایات کے مطابق یہ نام مقدس ہے، اسے بچوں کے نام دینے کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، اسے اللہ کی نعمت اور محبت کے شکر میں بچوں کا نام دیا جاتا ہے، یہ نام وہ لوگ بھی استعمال کرتے ہیں جنہیں اللہ کی برکتوں کا شکر ہوتا ہے، بعض اوقات اسے برکت اور شہرت کے لیے بھی استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، یہ نام اسلام کے مشایخ اور شاعرین کے ناموں میں سے ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुफ़लह
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुफ़लह: यह नाम अरबी भाषा के जड़ (फ-ल-ह) से मिलकर बना है, जिसका अर्थ है देवता और भगवान की भक्ति और प्रेम, यह कुरान में अच्छाई और भगवान के लिए एक अच्छा नाम है, इसे मुस्लिम धर्म में एक पवित्र नाम माना जाता है, और इसे बच्चों के नाम के रूप में इस्तेमाल किया जाता है, इसे देवता की कृपा और प्रेम के लिए धन्यवाद देने के रूप में इस्तेमाल किया जाता है, जो मुस्लिम धर्म में एक अच्छा काम है, कुछ लोग इसे अच्छाई और समृद्धि के रूप में भी इस्तेमाल करते हैं, और यह नाम भी मुस्लिम दार्शनिकों और कवियों के नामों में से एक है।

in_english.name: Muflah
in_english.long_meaning: Muflah: This name is derived from the Arabic root (F-L-H), meaning blessing and God's love. It is one of the names of the righteous in the Quran, and is considered a sacred name in Islam. It is used to name children as a thanksgiving for the blessings and love that God bestows. It also implies integrity and loyalty in fulfilling one's duty, and can mean good and righteousness. In some cases, it is used to name children as a blessing and glory, and is also one of the names of poets and scholars in Islam.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Muflah" holds significant cultural importance as it is an Arabic name that reflects intelligence and wisdom. In Islamic culture, the pursuit of knowledge is highly valued and seen as a lifelong journey. A name like Muflah would be seen as a source of pride for the family, instilling a sense of responsibility in the child to continue the tradition of seeking knowledge and wisdom.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name "Muflah" signifies a deep connection to the pursuit of knowledge and understanding of the divine. In Islamic belief, knowledge is a gift from Allah, and a means to draw closer to Him. By bestowing the name Muflah upon a child, the hope is that they will be guided towards a path of knowledge and wisdom that shall enrich their spiritual journey and bring them closer to their Creator.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abd al-Hakam, Futuh Al-Sham (The Conquest of Syria). In this historical work, Ibn Abd al-Hakam mentions a certain Muflah ibn al-Harith al-Kindi as a companion of Caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab during the conquest of Damascus in 634 AD.
historical_references.context: Accompanied Caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab during the conquest of Damascus

historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir, Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah (The Beginning and the End). Ibn Kathir discusses Muflah ibn al-Harith al-Kindi's role as the governor of Damascus on behalf of Caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab after the conquest in 634 AD.
historical_references.context: Governor of Damascus on behalf of Caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Muflah' is gaining modern significance in the context of Islamic finance and banking. Muflah was originally an Arabic term meaning 'bag' or 'pocket.' However, in today's world, it is associated with industries such as Islamic fintech, digital banking, and financial inclusion. Meezan Bank, based in Pakistan, has adopted the name for its mobile banking application, Meezan Mobile, which allows users to manage their finances digitally. Al Baraka Bank in Bahrain uses the term for its investment platform, Muflah, which offers Shariah-compliant investment solutions. In Canada, the Muslim Community Services of Toronto has established a financial services organization named Muflah, which focuses on serving the financial needs of the Muslim community while upholding Islamic principles.
